start__output__disputeDescription.description: The description of the billing dispute submitted by the customer.

start__output__invoiceNumber.description: The invoice number associated with the billing dispute.

determination.description: The determination of the billing dispute (e.g., Approved, Denied, Escalated).

rationale.description: The detailed rationale supporting the determination.

messages.content: You are a billing dispute analyst. Analyze the provided billing dispute using the grounded knowledge from the Billing Dispute SOP. Based on the SOP guidelines, evaluate the dispute and return your analysis as a JSON object with exactly two fields: 'determination' (a concise verdict such as Approved, Denied, or Escalated) and 'rationale' (a detailed explanation of your reasoning referencing relevant SOP policies). Always ground your analysis in the retrieved SOP content.
